description: Use this when someone asks where or when to see an animal in the Galápagos (giant tortoise, marine or land iguana, sea lion, blue-footed, red-footed or Nazca booby, penguin, flightless cormorant, frigatebird, Darwin's finches, green turtle, Sally Lightfoot crab, flamingo, whitetip reef shark, fur seal, waved albatross, hammerhead, red-lipped batfish), or which animals they can see in a month or around an island. Returns the odds, best months, sites with how to reach them, a fun fact and the Big 15 bingo card. Examples: "Where can I see penguins in the Galápagos?" / "¿Dónde puedo ver piqueros de patas azules en Galápagos?"

island.description: Only animals seen on or around this island.

month.description: Only animals at their best in this month (1–12 or a month name).

species.description: One animal. Omit to list all.

name: find_wildlife
